The deprotect tool returned an RDKit Mol object, not SMILES. We need to convert to SMILES maybe using some tool? Not provided. Could use map_reaction? Not. Could use get_available_functional_groups? Not. Maybe deprotect returns SMILES string? But result is object. Might need to use tool to get SMILES from Mol? Not available. Could instead use detect_protection_groups to see groups. But we need SMILES of deprotected molecule. Could try to use deprotect_molecule again? Not.

Maybe we can just ignore deprotection and search with product SMILES directly but maybe need to include functional groups broken: "carboxylic esters". The search returned empty. Could be because the product does not contain an ester; the template is forward reaction (ester -> aldehyde). The product is aldehyde/alcohol, so searching with product may not match because criteria refer to forward reaction (i.e., from product to precursors?). The search expects target molecule (product) and functional groups broken/formed in forward reaction (i.e., from precursors to product). So broken groups are those present in precursors but not in product: esters. Formed groups are aldehydes and aliphatic hydroxyls (present in product). So our criteria were correct. Yet no templates found. Maybe need to include "carboxylic esters" as broken and "aldehydes" and "aliphatic hydroxyls" as formed. Already did. Could be that the template is not in catalog for this specific product due to protecting groups interfering. So deprotect to get core product without silyl group, then search.

We need SMILES of deprotected molecule. Could use tool "detect_protection_groups" to identify groups and maybe remove them manually. Let's detect protection groups.
